title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → Verification

source_tables.description: Verification selection and tracking group on the ISIR.
Verification status for the aid year. FLAG: PeopleSoft spells the field VERIFICATON_STATUS in some releases; confirm.
Checklist header. Verification documents are usually a checklist assigned by 3C or the verification process.
Checklist items: each required document with status, due date, and status date.
ISIR transactions before and after correction, for SAI change.

notes: Most PeopleSoft schools track verification documents as checklist items. Filter PS_PERSON_CHECKLST to your verification checklist codes before mapping; other aid checklists (SAP appeal, PJ documentation) shouldn't land here.
privacy: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + EMPLID + AID_YEAR.
Resolve EMPLID to HELIX Student.helix_id through the identity crosswalk.
PeopleSoft AID_YEAR is the ending year: 2026 means 2025-2026. Emit '2025-2026'.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_STDNT_AID_ATRBT verification status + checklist item statuses
attribute_mappings.transformation: Derive through verification-status-xref: selected, documents_requested, documents_partial, documents_complete, in_review, conflicting_information, completed, incomplete, waived.
